patches.decision_note: The RIB page has a distinct cache-related failure while the legacy pages are reported working, demonstrating independently testable performance trajectories.
The source only discusses project funding and access; supporting context cannot supply the missing Requirement semantics.
Contacting WP Engine is a remediation plan and does not modify the required malware-removal behavior or scope.

replacement.title: Oak Bridge Search-Index Spam Cleanup
replacement.definition: Submit malicious Oak Bridge search-result URLs for removal from search engines.

patches.decision_note: Oak Bridge search-index cleanup is an independent operational behavior, and its access request and link submissions do not belong to the South Pointe cleanup or malware-removal Requirements.
The evidence does not safely establish whether full Thrive removal was client-confirmed or merely proposed and deferred while only Thrive Apprentice was disabled.
